items.title: Unifying Workers AI and AI Gateway into a single AI control plane
items.blurb: Cloudflare is unifying AI Gateway and Workers AI into a single control plane, giving developers observability, billing, and dynamic routing across both managed GPUs and external providers.

items.title: Cloudflare AI Search: give your agents a search engine for your data
items.blurb: AI Search makes search easier than ever, with no Cloudflare primitives to stitch together. Point it at your data to create a search for your own files and websites. We're also sharing a preview of our new pricing model.

items.title: The next generation of MCP
items.blurb: The next version of MCP has a rewritten, stateless core that just works on Workers. We cover upgrades to the protocol, the new feature lifecycle and SDK migration path, and hear from early adopters already running it in production.

items.title: Celld: Self-hosted, distributed Durable Objects
items.blurb: self-hosted, distributed Durable Objects. Contribute to denoland/celld development by creating an account on GitHub.

items.title: Unveiling good and bad behaviors on the Agentic Internet
items.blurb: Cloudflare is shifting bot mitigation from point-in-time Risk assessment to continuous Trust evaluation.

items.title: Announcing Cloudflare Ambassadors, Community Engineers, and another $1M in open-source funding
items.blurb: We are launching updated community programs, including Cloudflare Ambassadors and Community Engineers, backed by $1M in open-source funding. Learn how we are supporting maintainers and scaling our developer community.

items.title: A guide to slash commands in the GitHub Copilot app
items.blurb: Go beyond chat in the GitHub Copilot app with these slash commands. They'll help you plan, collaborate, automate, and customize your dev workflow.

items.title: How the GitHub legal team used Copilot CLI to streamline their workflows
items.blurb: Learn how to build tools to simplify how you work—without writing a single line of code. The post How the GitHub legal team used Copilot CLI to streamline their workflows appeared first on The GitHub Blog .

items.title: Introducing Radar Researcher: An AI tool for exploring Internet data in plain language
items.blurb: Cloudflare Radar Researcher is a new AI-powered tool that lets you explore global Internet trends and traffic data using plain language.

items.title: How and Why Netflix Built a Real-Time Distributed Graph: Part 3 — Querying the graph with gRPC…
DRY vs. SRP
items.blurb: After re-reading "Clean Architecture" I ended up with some confusion regarding Bob's take on repetition and single responsibility. Ge defines the SRP as a function only serving one actor.

items.title: How we took malware advisories beyond npm
items.blurb: GitHub malware advisories no longer stop at npm. Here's how we wired OpenSSF's malicious-packages data into the Advisory Database, and why we built the pipeline paranoid.
